verdict.rationale: doola documents its own official Formation MCP server, which lets a founder connect their own AI client and form a company with their own doola account, and a probe confirms the documentation exists at skill.md. The documented scope is narrow: it covers only forming a Wyoming LLC, and the evidence does not describe connection setup or a tool list. Missing for 10: MCP coverage beyond Wyoming LLC formation (compliance, EIN, documents), documented setup/auth/transport details and tool list, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
